POST /todos
  Creates one todo; the service assigns its id. Two identical posts make two todos.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  body: TodoInput
    not compared at 201 created_at: the service stamps its own clock and the model keeps no time of day
  201 → Todo: created; the id and the derived status come back; the fixture learns its id
  400 → Error: a field rule is broken: the first one, in field order
  401 → Error: no accepted credential
  503 → Error: the store is down; nothing was written or read
    why: The app cannot tell a saved todo from a lost one while the store is away, so it answers nothing rather than something false.
  carries: AddTodo
    refuses 400 'Title is required'
    refuses 400 'Title is too long'
    refuses 400 'Description is too long'
    refuses 400 'Due date must be a date'
    refuses 400 'Due date cannot be in the past'
      why: A chore due yesterday would show as overdue the moment it is written, so the app refuses it; a date already past is kept only when it is left unchanged.
    refuses 400 'No such user'

GET /todos/{id}
  Reads one todo.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  path:
    id  id of TodoRecord (string (uuid)) (required) — the todo's id
    not compared at 200 created_at: the service stamps its own clock and the model keeps no time of day
  200 → Todo: the todo, with its status as of the service's today
  404 → Error: no todo has this id, or it was removed
  401 → Error: no accepted credential
  503 → Error: the store is down; nothing was written or read
    why: The app cannot tell a saved todo from a lost one while the store is away, so it answers nothing rather than something false.
  carries: ReadTodo
    refuses 404 'Not found'

PUT /todos/{id}
  Replaces the whole todo with the body sent; a field left out is cleared.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  path:
    id  id of TodoRecord (string (uuid)) (required) — the todo's id
  body: TodoInput
    not compared at 200 created_at: the service stamps its own clock and the model keeps no time of day
  200 → Todo: the todo after the change
  400 → Error: a field rule is broken; nothing changed
  404 → Error: no todo has this id, or it was removed
  401 → Error: no accepted credential
  503 → Error: the store is down; nothing was written or read
    why: The app cannot tell a saved todo from a lost one while the store is away, so it answers nothing rather than something false.
  carries: ReplaceTodo
    refuses 404 'Not found'
    refuses 400 'Title is required'
    refuses 400 'Title is too long'
    refuses 400 'Description is too long'
    refuses 400 'Due date must be a date'
    refuses 400 'Due date cannot be in the past'
      why: A chore due yesterday would show as overdue the moment it is written, so the app refuses it; a date already past is kept only when it is left unchanged.
    refuses 400 'No such user'

DELETE /todos/{id}
  Removes one todo.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  path:
    id  id of TodoRecord (string (uuid)) (required) — the todo's id
  204 → no body: removed; the id never resolves again
  404 → Error: no todo has this id, or it was removed
  401 → Error: no accepted credential
  503 → Error: the store is down; nothing was written or read
    why: The app cannot tell a saved todo from a lost one while the store is away, so it answers nothing rather than something false.
  carries: RemoveTodo
    refuses 404 'Not found'

GET /todos
  Lists todos, all of them or the ones matching every filter sent.
  auth: bearer token or X-Api-Key header
  query:
    text      string — matches title or description, case folded
    assignee  'ana' | 'bo' — an unknown assignee matches nothing
    status    'unscheduled' | 'scheduled' | 'overdue'
    not compared at 200 [].created_at: the service stamps its own clock and the model keeps no time of day
  200 → [Todo]: the matches: overdue soonest first, then scheduled soonest first, then unscheduled newest first
  400 → Error: status is not one of the three
  401 → Error: no accepted credential
  503 → Error: the store is down; nothing was written or read
    why: The app cannot tell a saved todo from a lost one while the store is away, so it answers nothing rather than something false.
  carries: FindTodos
    refuses 400 'Unknown status'

GET /admin/clock
  Reads the service's today.
  auth: none
  200 → Clock: the day the service believes it is
  carries: TellDay

POST /admin/clock
  Moves the service's today.
  auth: none
  body: Clock
  204 → no body: today moved; every status is read against the new day
  400 → Error: not a date
  carries: MoveClock
    refuses 400 'Due date must be a date'

POST /admin/store
  Takes the store down or brings it back; while down every /todos call answers 503.
  auth: none
  body: Store
  204 → no body: the switch moved
  400 → Error: not a boolean
  carries: SwitchStore

POST /admin/reset
  Starts from nothing.
  auth: none
  204 → no body: empty store, the real date, store up
  carries: Wipe

AWeekOfChores
Ana plans her week. She writes down three chores, one with no date yet,
    hands one to Bo, finishes one and crosses it off, renames another, and moves
    the first one's due date back a day. Then she looks at what is left for her.

TheDayPasses
Bo schedules two chores for tomorrow and the day after, then two days go by.
    The first is overdue and rises to the top of the list; Bo can still rename it
    and keep its day, cannot move it to another day that has passed, and can push
    it to today.
ClearTheList\nAt the end of the week Ana removes everything, one chore at a time, and the\n    list says there is nothing to do. Removing one twice is turned away.

WrongTurns
Ana makes the mistakes a client can make: a blank title, a date that has
    passed, a colleague who does not exist, a status nobody defined, an id nobody
    issued, no credential at all. Each is turned away with its reason and the
    list is as it was. Then she gets it right, once with the other credential.
TheStoreIsDown\nThe store is unreachable. Nothing can be added or read, and the service\n    says so instead of pretending.
- **(none)**: no todo is listed. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **unscheduled**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with no due day. Reached by: POST /todos {"title": "Fix the gate"}.
- **scheduled**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with a due day on or after today. Reached by: POST /todos {"title": "Fix the gate", "due_on": "2026-11-06"}.
- **overdue**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with a due day before today. Reached by: POST /todos {"title": "Fix the gate", "due_on": "2026-11-06"}; POST /admin/clock {"today": "2026-11-07"}.
- **Serving**: every call with a credential reaches the store. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **StoreDown**: a call that would reach the store is turned away with 503. Reached by: POST /admin/store {"down": true}.
